limitations: Association status is source-conditioned crossmodal consistency. Shared q0/RGB/source-size/ROI/appearance can make both partitions stably wrong. No literal caption-target identity verification is implemented.

A/B partitions are disjoint observed points and independently rebuilt seed/normal graphs, but not independent scenes, sensor views or sourcebackbone inputs. Final G still fits all observed points; no heldout taskvalidation claim.

Uniform scalar weights are per-platform transductive means of the current unlabelled cohort, not purely per-case episodic adaptation. Active face terms can remain defined even if a particular accepted coordinate rounds unchanged.

Exact-coverage reliable_50 is a ranking control: if fewer than K defined scores exist, NA-last then hash can select undefined cases and apply original G. This is not the failclosed effective weighted_constraints method. Persisted control_defined and gate_selection make padding identifiable.
Component compatibility uses source-size hypotheses. Adjacent/background connections and sparse fragmentation can escape conflict detection; no semantic identity guarantee.
Actual source320 binding audit passed, but no actual reliability outputs, new targetGT scores or scientific gain are established by this pre-run implementation review.
